note: Candidate TONE3000 captures per modeled pedal (v0.4a, docs/specs/v0_4a-pedal_accuracy.md). Only tone/model ids and knob-label rules live here: never capture files; licence and creator are read from the API into the fits JSON. An empty "models" list means every model of that tone that is in the pool manifest and cached (restrict with `pedal-fit --model`). "assumed" maps an exact model name to pinned knobs when the name carries no full label; pins are reported as `assumed` and do not count for the v0.4 target check. Ids marked to_resolve are filled at run time with `sawblade-t3k search`, then added here.

hm.family: Boss HM-2 and clones (pedal.hm, default modelVersion 3)

tones.unit: HM-2 family (candidate from docs; identity to confirm by search)

hm.assumed_rule: Rotary pots run 7 o'clock (0) to 5 o'clock (10); 12 o'clock = 5, +1 per hour clockwise; 'maxed' = 10.

hmx.assumed_rule: 'Maxed' = every knob 10 (the Torcher's extra bands and presence are assumed maxed too); knobs the name does not carry are not labelled.

eye.assumed_rule: Eyemaster full distortion = gain 10; 'Gain12oclk' = gain 5. Level is solved in closed form, so 'Vol' is not pinned.

ts.label_note: v24x names (tone 30104), e.g. 39-TS808_Hot_LvlMax_OD5_T4 or 45-TS808_Hot_Lvl6_OD0_T5: Lvl<n> = Level, OD<n> = Drive, T<n> = Tone. Digits are taken as given on the 0-10 knob scale and 'Max' = 10. Level is a pure output gain (solved in closed form), so only drive and tone are pinned.

tones.unit: boost pack: TS circuits only (577277 TS 808 BOOST, 577278 TS 808 MOD)

ts.assumed_rule: Pins come from the v24x label_regex only (see label_note); the other 70280 models (DS-1, Klon, Grind, Hex, SansAmp, Badass, Plumes, SD-1) are not TS circuits and are listed in the report as 'Other circuits (not scored)' when a fits file holds them.

to_resolve.what: big-fuzz tone ids: add them to "tones" after the search

muff.assumed_rule: Resolved by search at run time; pin knobs only from labels in the model names.
